title: France 2027 Elections: A clash of two extremes could lead to 'easy' Le Pen win
summary: 🇫🇷 "You have a built-in danger in the system." The Financial Times' Victor Mallet argues #France's two-round system could leave centre voters choosing between two extremes in #2027elections, potentially opening the door to a far-right #LePen victory over the far-left.
